about: The starter set of status fields, offered when a story is made and adopted by the ones a story keeps. A story stores only the fields it adopted or wrote itself. 'hint' is what the model is told to write on that line. The name line is not here: it is built in, because a character's block is found by it.

fields.label: Day and time
fields.hint: the day and the time of day, as the story counts them

fields.label: Outfit
fields.hint: what they are wearing now, briefly

fields.label: Mood
fields.hint: up to three words for how they feel now
